PFR_conjecture_aux.statement: Let $G$ be a finite (in particular countable) elementary abelian $2$-group, i.e. a finite vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$. Let $A$ be a nonempty subset of $G$ with $|A+A|\le K|A|$. Then there exist a subgroup $H\le G$ and a set $c\subseteq G$ such that $|c|\le K^{13/2}|A|^{1/2}|H|^{-1/2}$, $|H|\le K^{11}|A|$, $|A|\le K^{11}|H|$, and $A\subseteq c+H$.

PFR_conjecture.statement: Let $G$ be a finite (in particular countable) elementary abelian $2$-group, i.e. a finite vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$. Let $A$ be a nonempty subset of $G$ with $|A+A|\le K|A|$. Then there exist a subgroup $H\le G$ and a set $c\subseteq G$ with $|c|<2K^{12}$, $|H|\le|A|$, and $A\subseteq c+H$.
